Source: a7m3-uiprobe13.log (scn_ui.c: inline hooks at GraphicsImage::clear/copy,
GRM_gpermFillrect/Rectblit, and the 0x73a100 2D submit).

UIINFO (libObj base, hook target addresses, expected first words):
UIINFO 0637c000 0698d590 b089b5f0 0698d9bc 4ff0e92d 4ff0e92d 4ff0e92d 41f0e92d 00000000 00000000

UIINST (install results + trampoline addresses):
UIINST 04097001 040f0001 050a5001 05724001 05e34001 04097001 040f0001 050a5001 05724001 05e34001

UIDONE (counts at the moment scenario_run() returned:
        nclear, ncopy, nfill, nrect, n2d):
UIDONE 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000

Whole-run counts across every scn_ui log (the hooks stay installed after return):
  UICLR (GraphicsImage::clear) = 0
  UICPY (GraphicsImage::copy)  = 0
  UIFILL (GRM_gpermFillrect)   = 0
  UIRECT (GRM_gpermRectblit)   = 0
  UI2D (0x73a100 submit)       = 15
Conclusion: the menu is not drawn through the CPU GraphicsImage/GRM paths;
the app submits 2D/GPU jobs through 0x73a100 instead.

UI2D records (2D scheduler job pointer + first 9 words):
UI2D 0c2fecec 2053b280 20558f70 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000001
UI2D 0c2fecec 20538220 20559530 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000002
UI2D 0c2fecec 2055f840 20558f80 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000003
UI2D 0c2fecec 2055f950 20559630 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000004
UI2D 0c2fecec 2053b280 2055f840 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000010
UI2D 0c2fecec 20538620 20560010 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000020
UI2D 0c2fecec 202e0200 22a80000 00000000 00000004 00000000 00004401 00000280 000001e0 00000030
UI2D 0c2fecec 2053b2f0 2055f850 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000040
UI2D 0c2fecec 20539420 2055ff10 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000050
UI2D 0c2fecec 20566170 2055f880 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000008 00000000 00000000 00000060

The 0x4401 job is the full-surface copy (640x480) from 0x202e0200 to 0x22a80000,
i.e. the likely display-buffer flip. Flags=8 jobs are small linear copies.
